WITH standings_races AS (
  SELECT r.name, ds.points
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
),
race_groups AS (
  SELECT name, AVG(points) as avg_points, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM standings_races
  GROUP BY name
),
avg_count_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) as average_count FROM race_groups
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT avg_points, cnt, (SELECT average_count FROM avg_count_val) as avg_cnt
  FROM race_groups
  WHERE cnt > (SELECT average_count FROM avg_count_val)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_points) as avg_of_points_avgs,
  AVG(cnt) as avg_of_counts,
  AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) as avg_of_diff
FROM filtered_groups
